description: Log-normal distribution survival function Phi(-(ln x - mu) / sigma) (location mu, scale sigma)

tolerance.reason: The reasoning of lognorm_cdf mirrored: rounding ln x and w = (ln x - mu) / sigma costs (|ln x| / sigma + |w|) phi(w) / Phi(-w) 2^-53, about |w| (|ln x| / sigma + |w|) 2^-53 in the upper tail, at most 3.2e-13 at a normal result on this grid (mu = 2, sigma = 4, w = 37.5); 8e-13 as for lognorm_cdf (2.5x). SciPy flushes the subnormal result at w = 38 to 0. Results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)

grid: the lognorm_cdf grid: (mu, sigma) in {(0, 0.25), (-3, 0.5), (0, 1), (2, 4)} x x = the double nearest exp(mu + sigma w) for w = -40..40 step 0.5, plus x = 0 and x = -1; 1 - F is 1 for x <= 0, subnormal from about w = 37.52, 0 above about w = 38.49 and rounds to 1 below about w = -8.3
